notes: Zones come from the LYNX NeighborLink layer (Date_Start Apr 26, 2026); the proposed and older layers in the same account are left out. Zone 831 is named Tupperware SunRail and Valencia College in the layer but North Kissimmee/Buena Ventura Lakes on golynx.com, so the website name is used. Rides can be booked through the Rides on Demand app or by calling (407) 244-0808; trips before 5:00 AM or after 8:00 PM must be booked in the app.
